summary: Verified restoration of deploy/ folder and related files from old upstream commit 9300287. All 13 deploy files present, bash syntax clean, docker-compose.yml parses and build contexts resolve, backend/Dockerfile and deploy/web.Dockerfile exist, .gitignore does not ignore deploy scripts, and frontend production build succeeds. Light regression: /api/projects returns group_year and maintenance_year fields. Only missing item: deploy/.env.example is present on disk but is UNTRACKED in git (not committed) in /app, so a future `git reset --hard origin/main` after a push would still omit it.

minor.issue: deploy/.env.example exists on disk but is UNTRACKED in /app git (only file missing from `git ls-files` compared to upstream 9300287). Main agent must `git add deploy/.env.example` before next Save-to-GitHub, otherwise users following the deploy steps won't have the env template on VPS.

test_maintenance_year_guards.py assertions failed for MH005 seed values (completion_year expected '2024' got '2026'; maintenance_value expected 3500000 got 0; MH005 2024 value expected 18500000 got 0). Appears to be seed-data drift after MariaDB restart in this preview, not a code regression. 3/6 maintenance tests still pass (year guards work).

action_items: git add /app/deploy/.env.example (currently untracked) before next Save-to-GitHub so VPS users get the env template.
Investigate seed data for MH005 (completion_year/maintenance_value) — regression tests expect 2024/3500000 but DB returns 2026/0. Either reseed or update test expectations.

Environment note: supervisor was running backend as 'RUNNING' while uvicorn had actually exited due to MariaDB being FATAL (invalid 'mysql' user on first boots). After `supervisorctl start mariadb` + `restart backend` everything came up. Not a code bug, but main agent should be aware MariaDB may need a kick after container restart.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy/docker-compose.yml build context for 'web' is '..' with dockerfile 'deploy/web.Dockerfile' and build args reference ${APP_DOMAIN}/${RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY:-} — verified these are documented in deploy/.env.example; just ensure the file is committed.
All 8 shell scripts (backup, update, setup, cron, cleanup, change-domain, gdrive-backup, reset-data) pass `bash -n` syntax check.
Frontend prod build with CI=false completes successfully — web.Dockerfile's `yarn build` step will work on VPS.

success_rate.backend: 100% for deploy-restoration checks; 50% (3/6) on legacy maintenance regression tests (seed drift)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy folder fully restored. Only tracked-file gap vs upstream 9300287 is deploy/.env.example which is on disk but untracked. rca of the issue: User's `bash: backup.sh: No such file or directory` was caused by the deploy/ folder being outside the Save-to-GitHub snapshot. Main agent copied files back from /tmp/crmold (upstream 9300287). Verification: `comm -23 <(cd /tmp/crmold && git ls-files) <(cd /app && git ls-files)` → only `deploy/.env.example` remains missing from the /app git index (file is on disk but not git-added). Mitigation: run `cd /app && git add deploy/.env.example` and commit before next Save-to-GitHub.
